name: beau_rivage
description: Beau Rivage is a classic calligraphic with strong contrast between thick and thin strokes. Perfect for invitations and posh events. Utilize the stylistic sets which contain ornamental caps and more flourished lower case forms. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/beau-rivage .
